title: MCP-UI Resource (A2UI over MCP Apps)
description: Expresses the MCP-UI resource carried inside an MCP tool-call result. This repo does NOT define MCP-UI; this file encodes someone else's transport so constraint validation has a deterministic local source of truth. The PAYLOAD, however, is deliberately constrained to A2UI: see the architecture note in $comment.
$comment: ARCHITECTURE — WHY THE PAYLOAD IS A2UI, NOT FREE-FORM HTML. An agent exposes MCP, HTTP, A2A, and AG-UI endpoints simultaneously, and a client may arrive over any of them. The UI must be the SAME regardless of transport. A2UI is that shared vocabulary; MCP-UI is one ENVELOPE that carries it, alongside AG-UI (web) and a2ui_flutter (mobile). Admitting arbitrary HTML here would let the MCP surface drift from the AG-UI and Flutter surfaces — the exact inconsistency this content type exists to prevent. || CONSEQUENCE: `a2ui` messages are REQUIRED. The `text` field holds a minimal host page that renders them; it is generated scaffolding, not authored markup. || WHY THIS WORKS INSIDE THE SANDBOX: the A2UI renderer is FED messages (MessageProcessor.processMessages takes an array) rather than fetching them. So the surface renders with `connect-src: none` — the MCP-UI sandbox default. Verified against assets/scaffold/a2ui/a2ui-surface.tsx. || PROVENANCE. Transport: MCP-UI-Org/mcp-ui (Apache-2.0) + @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps (MIT). Encoded against SHIPPED TYPE DECLARATIONS vendored at .kbd-orchestrator/phases/phase-9-scaffold-mcp-ui/evidence/. Payload: a2ui-project/a2ui v1.0, validated by references/schemas/a2ui-component.schema.json. || MIMETYPE: `text/html;profile=mcp-app` is what BOTH shipped packages emit (verified by grep). Bare `text/html` is the legacy spelling. `text/uri-list` appears in NEITHER package. || NARROWING: `blob`, `remoteDom`, and `externalUrl` are out of scope — the latter two are distinct CONTENT SHAPES upstream, not mimeTypes, so there is no mimeType literal to exclude; they are refused structurally by additionalProperties:false. || VALIDATOR LIMITS (verified by fixture, not assumed): the shipped validator implements `enum` but NOT `const`, and `oneOf` RETURNS EARLY so sibling keywords are never evaluated. Each branch below is therefore self-contained. Do not hoist shared constraints — that silently disables them.

type.description: EmbeddedResource discriminator. @mcp-ui/client's isUIResource narrows on this. Single-value `enum` rather than `const`: the shipped validator (scripts/normalize-a2ui.mjs) implements enum but NOT const, so a const here would be silently inert — the same defect class phase-8 found with oneOf.

uiResource.description: The ui:// resource. Each oneOf branch is SELF-CONTAINED because the shipped validator returns as soon as it evaluates oneOf. additionalProperties:false is what refuses the remoteDom (script/framework) and externalUrl (iframeUrl) content shapes.
